resources.string: Raven VPN uses Android\'s VpnService to create a secure, encrypted network tunnel between your device and our VPN nodes.

Android\'s VpnService is the core system API that enables Raven VPN to establish an encrypted tunnel. This protects your network packets from interception when connecting through public Wi-Fi or untrusted networks.
What data is routed, collected, and transmitted?

1. Device Traffic: All outgoing and incoming internet traffic is routed through the encrypted tunnel to the selected VPN node.\n2. Connection Metadata: To provision your session and manage server capacity, the app transmits an app-generated installation ID, device model name, and selected server node ID to our control plane.\n3. Content Privacy: The Raven VPN client application does not monitor, inspect, or store your browsing content, DNS destinations, or visited websites.
